dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>This town has really gotten brighter thanks to you and
your friends, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,663)><$voicel(1,3)>But we’re still not seeing a fully bloomed flower field on
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s head.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>It seems like we’re almost there, but... What else can we
possibly do?

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Hmmm... I’m not certain we could make it much brighter
if we tried.
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>Urk! That seems a little harsh...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Pardon me, if I may?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>While I was out and about in town, I stumbled upon quite
an intriguing device.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Now, if this device does what I THINK it does...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>It may be just what we need to finally wake <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! Now that IS intriguing! Where is this device?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>It’s right this way. Please, follow me!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Yes, this device may be just what we need...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>It’s this way. Please, follow me!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Follow <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>And here we are—the device in question!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Fascinating... How exactly does one use it?

<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>If my theory is correct, we must first connect this machine
to <$voicel(2,8)>an electrical current.

<$voicel(2,7)>Look here—this shape indicates it should be able
to store electricity.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>I see. So first we run electricity into this device, correct?
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,1)><$lookat(1,0,0)><$lookat(2,0,0)>Do you know how to do that, <$cdef(27)>?

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Exactly right! This machine requires a large amount of
electricity, you see.
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Instead of relying on a Pokémon for just a temporary
charge, <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I would like you to use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to
connect this to a <$cdef(27)>generator.

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,663)><$voicel(2,6)>Errr, not quite. This device requires a great deal of
electricity, you see.
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Instead of relying on a Pokémon for just a temporary
charge, <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I would like you to use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to
connect this to <$cdef(27)>generators.
<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,9)>Understood. Thanks for explaining so clearly!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Right then, <$cdef(27)>. It sounds like
<$cdef(27)>Peakychu’s
got
a
plan
of sorts.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>So, do you think you could set up some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>to
carry a lot of electricity from the <$cdef(27)>generators to this device?

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m sorry to trouble you so, but we’re relying on your
help, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>I would like you to send lots of electricity from the
<$cdef(27)>generators to this device!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>In order to do that, you’ll need to use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to
connect this device to the <$cdef(27)>generators.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho! It lit up! What do you think, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu? <$lookat(1,0,2)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Think this
device is usable now?
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>Let us test it out right away!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Well? Is it working?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,667)><$voicel(2,1)>My apologies. It appears we still need more electricity...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Is that so...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>It appears we’ll need to increase the volume of
electricity by using more <$cdef(27)>generators...

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>I am so sorry to ask for your help again and again,
<$cdef(27)>...
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>But could I ask you to connect even more <$cdef(27)>generators to
this device?

There are a few different <$cdef(27)>generators in this town.
If one doesn’t produce enough electricity, try to find a
second <$cdef(27)>generator—or even a third—and connect their
electrical currents to this machine.

You can also buy <$cdef(27)>building kits at the <$cdef(27)>PC and use them to
build <$cdef(27)>generators anywhere you please!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-what was that?! I just heard a zap—was that you?

<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Phew!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Thanks to <$cdef(27)>, it seems this device
was
already
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>linked
to
a
sufficient
electrical
current!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>And as a result, I was able to charge my cheeks with plenty
of electricity!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho! Are you saying you can use electricity again?!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Well, as I had guessed, I still cannot GENERATE
electricity...
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>But this device has allowed me to ABSORB plenty of it!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>And now I have a very special move in mind—one I’ve
been waiting a very long time to use!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>What in the world are you planning?

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>This particular move ought to light up the town even
brighter than it already is! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, without further ado...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$textsize(2)>PIIIKAAA...CHUUUUUU!!!</textsize>

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>I would like you to send lots of electricity from the
<$cdef(27)>generators to this device!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>In order to do that, you’ll need to use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to
connect this device to the <$cdef(27)>generators.

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>I can sense it... This time we have plenty of electricity
stored up!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, I had better try it out posthaste. I’m so nervous my
cheeks are tingling!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>I hope this works...
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,8)>Wh-what was that?! I just heard a zap—was that you?

<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>Phew!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)><$cdef(27)> sent all the energy we needed
to
this device!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>As a result, I was able to charge my cheeks with plenty
of electricity!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Oho! Are you saying you can use electricity again?!

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Well, as I had guessed, I still cannot GENERATE
electricity...
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>But this device has allowed me to ABSORB plenty of it!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>And now I have a very special move in mind—one I’ve
been waiting a very long time to use!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>What in the world are you planning?

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>This particular move ought to light up the town even
brighter than it already is! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Well, without further ado...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,9)><$textsize(2)>PIIIKAAA...CHUUUUUU!!!</textsize>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,10)>Oho! Would you look at that! So incredibly bright!
<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Phew! That went well, I think. Was I of any help at all?

<$lookat(1,0,2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Most certainly! I had no idea you could use a move
like that!
<$lookat(4,0,2)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,7)>You’re AMAZING, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>!
<$lookat(5,0,2)><$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>My coin’s all shiny too!
<$lookat(6,0,2)><$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,803)><$voicel(6,8)>Yooo! It’s BEAUTIFUL, <$cdef(27)>Peakychu</color>! And so bright!

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>Tee-hee! Thank you all for your kind words. I’m just glad I
was able to be of use...

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Well then, shall we go check in on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax and see how
they’re doing?
